reason: I already take Toplux and reorder when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Magnesium is not something I am short on, and I forget my vitamins half the time anyway.
objection: Why one form of magnesium when others have 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate alone feels like less for $30, and I already have a brand I reorder.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing it side by side with my current one, with a clear reason one form beats eight, at around the same price or lower.
